appendix: Appendix B: Student survey results summary

glossary.definition: Learning Management System for course content delivery
Grade Point Average calculated per semester

references: Competitor Analysis: Student Portal Benchmarking Report

in_scope: Fee payment integration with university finance system
assumptions: Students have access to internet-connected devices
Integration APIs with existing ERP are available and documented
constraints: Must integrate with existing Banner ERP system
Go-live deadline fixed at start of Fall 2026 semester

risk_analysis.risk: ERP integration failure during peak registration period
risk_analysis.mitigation: Conduct integration testing at least 2 months before go-live

risk_analysis.risk: Low student adoption of new portal
risk_analysis.mitigation: Run awareness campaigns and provide tutorial videos

risk_analysis.risk: Data privacy breach of student academic records
risk_analysis.mitigation: Penetration testing and third-party security audit before launch

current_process.overview: Students visit physical offices for most administrative tasks including registration, transcript requests and fee payments
pain_points: No single platform for all student services
Manual document submission prone to loss
Limited office hours restricting student access

kpis: Reduce in-person visits by 70% within first semester
Process 90% of transcript requests within 48 hours
goals: Provide 24/7 self-service access for all student administrative needs
Improve student satisfaction scores in annual survey
business_drivers.need_for_change: Student expectations for digital services have grown significantly while university processes remain manual and office-dependent

executive_summary.problem: Students lack a unified digital platform for academic and administrative self-service leading to high operational costs and poor student experience
expected_benefits: Reduced administrative burden on university staff
Improved student satisfaction and retention rates
Cost savings through reduced paper-based processing
executive_summary.proposed_solution: Develop a comprehensive student self-service portal integrating course management, financial services, and document processing
executive_summary.company_description: Mid-sized private university with approximately 12,000 enrolled students

functional_requirements.description: Students can register for courses within defined registration windows
System displays real-time seat availability per course section
Students can view and download official grade transcripts
Automated email notification upon successful registration or waitlist addition
Online fee payment supporting credit card and bank transfer
Academic advisor appointment booking through portal

performance: System handles 3000 concurrent users during peak registration without slowdown
security: Session timeout after 15 minutes of inactivity
usability: Interface accessible on mobile browsers without dedicated app
Support for both Arabic and English language switching
